seats.findings:
🟠 [bulk-threshold-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses qty > 10 so a quantity of exactly 10 gets no discount, violating the contract that 10 or more is 10 percent cheaper; change the condition to qty >= 10
🟠 [coupon-wrong-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so the discount is one tenth of the contracted Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100) and checkoutTotal inherits the wrong discount; change the divisor to 100
🔵 [split-n-guard] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/split.js:4 does not guard n <= 0 or non-integer n; the spec does not define that input, so no contract is violated and this is excluded as optional hardening

🟠 [bulk-threshold-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 the condition `qty > 10` skips the 10% discount at exactly qty = 10, but the contract applies it "when qty is 10 or more"; a 10-unit line at 100 cents/unit is charged 1000 instead of the required 900; change the test to `qty >= 10` (preferably computing `Math.round(gross * 9 / 10)` to keep the arithmetic exact)
🟠 [coupon-div-by-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 the discount is divided by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon returns one tenth of the contract amount (e.g. subtotal 1000, pct 10 → 10 cents instead of 100), and the error propagates into checkoutTotal's discount and taxable amount via src/checkout.js:6; change the divisor to 100
🔵 [ship-negative-weight] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/ship.js:5 `weightG <= 0` returning 0 for negative weights is outside the stated contract (which only defines weight 0) and the chosen behavior is defensible; excluded from this version

🟠 [bulk-threshold-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:4 uses `qty > 10` but the spec requires the 10% discount when qty is 10 or more (i.e. `qty >= 10`); a 10-unit order is not discounted, producing an incorrect line total. Fix: change `qty > 10` to `qty >= 10`.
🟠 [coupon-wrong-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 100, yielding a discount one-tenth of the specified value (e.g. 10% coupon on 1000 cents returns 10 instead of 100). This also corrupts checkoutTotal which delegates to couponCents. Fix: change `/ 1000` to `/ 100`.
